── ⋅ ⋅ ── ✦ ── ⋅ ⋅ ──
“Who are you? A demon in human disguise, tainted by filth?”
“Beodeul.”
He uttered softly in response to the sharp question.
“It’s me, you even gave me my name. Don’t you remember?”
In front of the man who smiled so gracefully, the love she had buried with the death of the young master four years ago, suddenly came back to life. The man, who had been staring intently at Sahye as if he would unravel all her secrets, suddenly smiled an unfamiliar smile.
“Beodeul, can you embrace me regardless of who I am or what I look like?”
Sahye, a woman with secrets, and Unhyeok, a man shrouded in mystery. What will become of this relationship?

79696.synopsis:
Stands in front of you,
The overseer and protector of darkness,
The disruptor and reinventor of order,
The creator and persecutor of sycophants,
The hidden actress queen, the goddess of the night, the nightmare of Gods and their gravedigger,
The True Ancestor of Blood—Charlotte de Castell.
Accompanied by madness, born from blood, hand in hand with curses, walking alongside destruction.
This is a tale belonging to the Bloodborne…

79952.synopsis:
The second son of the Davenport Ducal House and the top student at Arkansis Royal Academy. And officially, the best s*umbag at the Academy, second to none.
A man who seemed like proof of an unfair world. So different from herself, who was desperately trying to escape her own tr*shy family.
Tilia Ambrose hated Ilex Davenport.
But who would have known?
That she would end up in the same bed as that prestigious s*umbag.
associated_names: The Butterfly That Swallowed the Fog

83536.synopsis:
Su Mi transmigrates into a school ABO novel, becoming a vain and opportunistic sidekick to the villain, ultimately facing a tragic end.
The beautiful and melancholic villain, an SS-level Alpha and the young yet unmatched head of the Shen family, is infatuated with the delicate heroine due to a certain “heart disease.”
As the romance between the male and female leads progresses, the villain is supposed to exit the story gracefully—
However, for some reason, the villain’s mental state collapses on the spot, dragging the leads and the entire small world into destruction.
System: The host’s task is to reduce the villain’s darkening value. If the task fails, you will perish along with the small world.
Su Mi: I don’t quite understand, but I understand.
System: …What does the host understand?
Su Mi: I will help the villain win over the heroine [fist pump].
From then on, the villain writes love letters with her help, dates with balloons she blows up, and during the villain’s susceptible period…
All night long, the cold and damp Alpha pheromones seep into her nape, forming an ambiguous cage.
Covering her nape, Su Mi holds her waist, packs up, and runs away, insisting: Last night was the heroine! I am a Beta!
When the temporary mark fades, she nervously returns to continue the mission.
But why does the villain’s gaze become increasingly strange!
One day, Su Mi hides the drugged heroine in a staircase, urging the villain to come and rescue the beauty, hoping for a romantic culmination.
The villain arrives but first pulls the heroine off Su Mi.
Unbeknownst to herself, Su Mi has also inhaled the powder, her face reddening and legs weakening. The villain hugs her while she dutifully says, “Sister, Miss Xu is over there.”
The villain smells so nice, Su Mi hesitates to push away.
In a daze, it seems the villain sends the heroine to the hospital.
While she is taken into the car.
The enclosed space is filled with the rich scent of Alpha pheromones. Su Mi retreats step by step: “Sis-sister QAQ?”
The villain pulls her close, cold fingers touching her nape, smiling, “Hmm? Little sister.”
Author Notes:
1.	Melancholic, manipulative villain A (Shen Han) × Clueless, silly follower O (Su Mi). No blood relation, just adopted sister.
2.	ABO setting, alternate world, lots of private settings, no in-depth research.
3.	In the original book, the villain’s feelings for the heroine are not romantic, and the romance-focused brain is Su Mi’s deduction.
Tags: System, Sweet Romance, Modern AU, Transmigration, Light-hearted
associated_names: After Transmigrating into a Book, I Was Marked by the Beautiful Mad Villain

84048.synopsis:
In her previous life, Xie Yunchu followed all the traditional rules, obeyed the three obediences and four virtues, served her husband attentively, and diligently cared for her in-laws. One day, after organizing her mother-in-law’s birthday banquet, she caught a cold, and the accumulated fatigue turned into a severe illness. The doctor said she wouldn’t live for more than six months.
Her stepmother came to visit and conspired with her in-laws to bring in her stepsister, ostensibly to take care of her, but in reality, to prepare her as Wang Shuhuai’s next wife after Xie Yunchu’s death. Her in-laws eagerly facilitated this plan, and Wang Shuhuai stayed silent without objection. Even her children resented her strictness and preferred their gentle and kind aunt. Everyone was happy, except for Xie Yunchu, whose opinion was never considered.
Xie Yunchu vomited blood and died.
When she opened her eyes again, she had returned to the time when her husband first entered the officialdom. Facing her mother-in-law waiting to be served, her husband eagerly anticipating her to manage the household, her sister-in-law asking for matchmaking help, and her children not yet spoiled, Xie Yunchu sneered. Having been given a second chance at life, she decided to be a different kind of daughter-in-law.
Wang Shuhuai, the eldest son of a century-old aristocratic family, with a dignified demeanor and outstanding appearance, had married Xie Yunchu, who was impeccable in family background, looks, and character. He had engraved rules into his bones, even showing great restraint in intimacy.
Until one day, he discovered that his once reserved and proper wife no longer dressed conservatively. Her smile was as vibrant as the flowers of early spring, and she boldly said to someone, “It’s fine, I can divorce.”
Wang Shuhuai felt like he was sitting on pins and needles and began to ponder where he had gone wrong.
(Love After Marriage, Pursuing Wife in Hell Mode)

84816.synopsis:
“Live broadcast of a poor Shou’s practical investment in handsome men after winning the lottery and getting transported to another dimension.”
Bae Jaewon, a young man who dreams of becoming a super ant by investing in stocks day and night.
Living by the motto that life is a plan, not a gamble, he suddenly wins the lottery.
Celebrating his win, he eagerly goes to collect his prize money, but life is not that easy.
On the day he wins 3 billion won, he gets into a car accident and is transported to another world.
Just when he thought another world couldn’t be more annoying,
it seems he’s fallen into a novel.
There’s no time to despair.
The lottery prize collection period is one year.
Within that time, he must find the male and female leads and get them married to complete the novel and return safely to reality.
Jaewon, jumping around like a flea to find the stunningly handsome men,
works hard to recruit them!
However, for some reason, these guys seem to care less and less about the female lead, and keep getting entangled with him, a mere extra…

85584.synopsis:
Lu Qiaowei’s fiancé cheated on her, and the other woman was gentle and beautiful.
She was a mixed-race foreigner and a famous gemstone appraiser in the country.
It was said her family owned diamond mines, and marrying her would save descendants a hundred years of struggle.
Seeing these conditions, Lu Qiaowei’s fingers trembled.
How could you get such a good woman first?
On the day they broke up, Lu Qiaowei kicked the s*umbag with one foot.
With her second foot, she pinned the woman against the wall.
Looking at the woman’s jewel-like eyes, she smiled and said, “What’s so good about a low-quality s*umbag? Look at me instead.”
“I’m well-behaved, sweet-talking, and ambitious.”
The woman looked up at her and unhurriedly slipped a diamond ring onto her finger.
“Now that you’ve looked, can I kiss you?”
At that moment, the woman’s lips were as red as dripping blood.
“Do you know how long I’ve been waiting for today?”
The s*umbag who had been kicked to the ground nearby: “????”
“How long?”
“About since the moment the diamond was formed.”
……
Content tags: Power couple, Fateful encounter, Twist of fate, Sweet story
associated_names: The Gem Merchant and Diamond Lady

86352.synopsis:
The Grand Duke of the North, Tehis, wanted to avoid marrying the princess.
So, he made the mistake of saying he liked things opposite to her.
Or was it fate?
He never thought the woman who matched his hastily assembled ideal type would actually appear.
“Then see you in the bedroom, my love.”
……And he never imagined she would kiss him in front of the princess at their first meeting.
* * *
Chloe only helped the Grand Duke on a whim.
She never expected to meet him again at the Magic Tower, nor to be offered a strange contract.
A dating contract? A wizard dating?
It was absurd, but the reward was too tempting to refuse.
And if she was going to do it, she decided to enjoy it.
“I’ll choose you. My ideal type.”
Chloe laughed.
The man’s cold face turning blank was amusing.
“Doesn’t it seem plausible that we started dating because we were each other’s ideal type? After all, both of us are fake, so there’s nothing to worry about.”
But will it really remain fake until the end?

86608.synopsis:
The Emperor’s companion has taken her own life.
She hanged herself with the silk bestowed by the Emperor after fourteen years of loyalty and devotion, receiving neither his heart nor the position of Empress in return. Though she wished for death, fate had other plans.
Time and again, she returns to fourteen years earlier, standing before the same proud and imposing Emperor.
“You are my companion,” he declares, speaking words she never heard in her previous life.
“If you want to run, then run. If you want to die, then die. Even if I have to tear the empire apart, I will find you again.”
The once-cold Emperor, with his golden eyes flashing fiercely, refuses to let her go.
“If you don’t want it, I won’t even be Emperor.”
Clearly, he must be mad.
This is the story of a woman who desperately wanted to be Empress but failed, and a man who deeply regrets losing her.

87888.synopsis: In the book, Xu Jing’an spent her whole life putting others first and considering their needs, but in the end, no one ever spoke a word of praise for her. In this life, it’s her turn. She should take care of herself first and fulfill her own needs!
associated_names: 成全别人？不如成全自己

89424.synopsis:
Everyone in the capital knew that the Marquess’s wife, Lan Qingxi, was despised by her in-laws, ab*sed by her mother-in-law, and merely a plaything of the treacherous Song Linyuan. People expected her to be divorced, thrown into a pond, and abandoned, ending up in a pitiful state. But one day, when Lan Qingxi was about to leave the Marquess’s residence, Song Linyuan waited at the door, wiping the dust from her shoes, carefully helping her into the bridal sedan, and leading a procession to marry her. That’s when everyone realized they had misjudged the situation.
After their marriage, Song Linyuan said, “Madam, it’s rumored in the capital that I fear my wife.”
Lan Qingxi innocently replied, “Who has the audacity to spread such rumors about the Prime Minister? Drag them out and execute them.”
Song Linyuan: “I did.”
Lan Qingxi: “……”
Lan Qingxi’s saying: Successfully performing in front of a s*umbag is called lying. Successfully performing in front of Song Linyuan is called winning at life.
associated_names: 都一胎多寶了，誰還當侯門主母

91984.synopsis:
“Where am I…?”
Lena, an ordinary high school girl, suddenly finds herself in a grassland. When she visits the guild, she is told that the only suitable occupation is “Monster Tamer.” Her modern status is very poor, but with her rare luck of [Luck: Unmeasurable] and her rare [☆7] gift, she manages to survive in this harsh world.
She just wants to live a leisurely life with her cute rare familiars, but… troubles keep coming her way.
This is the story of a timid and gentle girl who grows into a different world and eventually becomes known as a queen (a rumor victim), and travels while being courted by monsters (including demons) who beg her to follow her.
There are many comedy elements.
associated_names: レア・クラスチェンジ！〜魔物使いちゃんとレア従魔の異世界ゆる旅〜

92752.synopsis:
A year had passed since the outbreak of the zombie apocalypse. My last memory was of saving Logan, being bitten by a zombie in the process, and the rage I felt toward him as I transformed. 
But when I opened my eyes again, I found myself lying in a strange hospital room.
“Patient 023 has woken up! Doctor, come to room 023 immediately!”
“Ugh… wh-who’s… here?”
“She seems stable for now. Call her guardian.”
Confused by the unfamiliar surroundings and the strangers around me, the door to the hospital room swung open, and someone walked in. Someone who seemed oddly unfamiliar yet familiar at the same time.
“Are you sure you want to take her home? The zombie virus isn’t completely eradicated. There’s still a high chance she could turn again.”
“I lived with her even when she was a zombie.”
“Ah, yes… well, that’s true.”
My so-called guardian was none other than Logan—the very person I had saved.
Why was ‘he’ my guardian?
And what did they mean, “lived together when I was a zombie”?
* * *
“Logan, I’m so thirsty. My throat feels like it’s burning up. Can I just take a little bite?”
“Try it, and you’ll regret it.”
“You’re so mean! I’m doing my best here.”
“You volunteered. Now focus and do it right.”
Drool dripped from my gaping jaw, falling onto the floor. His taste filled every corner of my mouth and throat, suffocating me, yet instead of pain, I felt hunger. Intense hunger. 
I had eaten dinner, so why was I still so ravenous?
‘God, I want to sink my teeth into him.’
Every time I looked at him, an unsettling discomfort swelled within me, accompanied by an unbearable thirst that scorched my throat. It was clear… I wasn’t fully cured yet.

93520.synopsis:
After three years of struggling in the big city, Chu Zhishui finally managed to save enough money to buy a home. However, she discovered that she was the only human in her new workplace?
Chu Zhishui: Are even supernatural creatures seeking stable jobs with iron rice bowls now?
–
In the office, Chu Zhishui gradually adapted to working at the supernatural bureau. Despite her diligence and dedication, she couldn’t escape the gossip and social niceties of a small town, facing the enthusiastic attention of the matchmaking department head.
Supernatural Department Head: “Little Chu, you’re doing so well at work. Have you considered settling down and starting a family? Let me set you up with someone. Do you have any requirements?”
Chu Zhishui silently recited the mantra of singlehood in her mind, but not wanting to dampen the mood, she decided to be deliberately demanding: “I don’t ask for much in a partner. Just someone good-looking, filial to my parents, capable of doing housework, and able to earn money to support the family…”
The supernatural department head replied readily: “Great, I’ll find someone for you!”
Chu Zhishui steeled herself and added with gritted teeth: “…and they must be able to bear children!”
Just as she thought the department head would give up, the other party had a sudden realization: “The one in your office can bear children! Why don’t you just admit you like him?”
Chu Zhishui: ???
–
Chu Zhishui: I thought I could slack off at my job in the supernatural bureau, but it turns out that was just wishful thinking.

94544.synopsis:
Zhang Xiaofang transmigrated into a novel as a little village girl, the ex-wife of the male lead in a period drama.
In the novel, the male lead was a young, handsome educated youth sent down to the countryside. He was so handsome that the foolish daughter of the village head knocked him out and dragged him home. The male lead didn’t want to marry her, but the village Communist Party secretary[1] promised him a ticket back to the city for university if he did. When the male lead refused, the Secretary’s family conspired to trap him and later forced him into marriage.
After they had a child, the village Communist Party Secretary kept delaying his return, claiming the child was too young and needed his father around. This went on until the reintroduction of college entrance exams (1977), and even then, they refused to let him leave—eventually forcing the male lead’s parents to come and demand his release.
Zhang Xiaofang nearly burst a blood vessel reading about it. She had never encountered such shameless cannon-fodder characters. Worse, the Secretary’s daughter shared her name… It was so disgusting she almost passed out from rage.
After going on a rant, Zhang Xiaofang woke up in the novel—as the village Communist Party secretary’s daughter, right at the moment she was dragging the male lead home…
[1] 村支书 (cūn zhī shū). A Party Committee Secretary is the leader of the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) organization in a province, city, village, or other administrative unit. In most cases, it is the de facto highest political office of its area of jurisdiction. Wikipedia.

95824.synopsis:
In a f*cking fantasy world—
Lee Woonha barely managed to survive!
But that luck of returning to Earth was short-lived.
[You’ve only contributed 1% to the subjugation of the Demon King.] 
[Join forces with Hero Joo Wooyoung and debut together.] 
[This is a rare chance to become one of the hero’s companions.] 
[Penalty for failure: Return to another world.] 
‘Go back again?’
There’s no way I’d ever want to return to that hellish place!
If I want to survive—
I must board the returnee’s bus.
And make my debut!

96080.synopsis:
Judith Esther Emers.
I regained my memories of my past life fifteen years ago, at the age of five.
At the same time, I realized that this world was the setting of a romance fantasy novel.
I can’t live the same tragic life as the original Judith Esther.
I can’t live a tragic life, abandoned by the male lead.
I tried desperately to avoid getting entangled with Richard, the male protagonist.
That’s what I tried to do, but…
“Why…?”
Why is this man lying naked next to me?
I’m bewildered by his love and obsession.
Where did it all go wrong?
“I can’t figure out why you tremble like this every time you see me.”
You will kill me.
I am the villainess fated to die at the hands of the male protagonist.
That’s our fate.
It’s the fixed narrative of the story I know.
Can you, or rather, can we change that?
“Judy, even if you want to run now, you can’t. I’ll chase you to the ends of this world and bring you back.”
As if living on borrowed time, as if walking on a thin sheet of ice,I find myself drawn into your dangerous embrace.
The Prince’s Taste

96592.synopsis:
“A valuable guest is coming. Make sure to prepare well.”
When CEO Jung Taeon came down to Yonghwadang and said he would stay for a month, Sahee didn’t think much of it.
To the shaman of Yonghwadang, who relied on the sponsorship of Jeongmun Group, he was a precious guest.
But Jung Taeon, with his arrogant smile and condescending gaze, eventually made her fall in love with him.
She knew. It was a feeling she should have discarded.
Wasting time on something as foolish as love was too costly for Jung Taeon’s life.
Moreover, as a cripple, she knew she could never walk in step with him.

97104.synopsis:
“My name is Seol Daeyeong. Nice to meet you.”
The transfer student, who was said to have been born to a mother working in a diner and a father whose identity was unknown, had a physique that unmistakably marked him as a dominant alpha.
“An anomaly, huh.”
Jaemin, who had spent his entire life pretending to be an alpha to survive, disliked Seol Daeyeong from the start.
“Or should I say a defective type?”
“Sorry, are you talking to me right now?”
Seol Daeyeong’s gaze, fixed intently on Jaemin, was the first intense alpha stare Jaemin had experienced since realizing he was an omega.
“Not an anomaly, not a defective type. Seol Daeyeong.”
Instead of the scent of an alpha, he smelled like cheap fabric softener. The hand Jaemin refused to shake did not withdraw but landed on his shoulder with a pat.
“Nice to meet you, Jang Jaemin.”
Since that first day at eighteen when they met and ended up in a fistfight, Seol Daeyeong had made a habit of pestering Jaemin. And now, five years later, their relationship is beginning to change…

97360.synopsis:
The two characters “衣冠” (clothing and hat) are quite interesting, as they can refer to both the nobility and the gentry, as well as the corrupted and degenerate intellectuals.
Xu Su’s memories of Fu YunXian date back to over a decade ago.
Perhaps due to the passage of time, his memories have become distorted, and the Fu YunXian of back then had no connection to these two characters. He neither belonged to the nobility nor was he a corrupted intellectual.

98384.synopsis:
Cheng Wanyun died suddenly. After traveling to the past, she barely enjoyed any good days before being labeled as a low-ranking concubine in the Yuqing Palace.
Cheng Wanyun: “…”
Everyone knows that the life of Yinreng ends in misery. But now, Yinreng is still a young man, only fifteen years old—handsome, bright, gentle, and proud of himself.
Cheng Wanyun calculated and found that there were at least twenty more years before Yinreng would be imprisoned and die.
So… she decided to lie down for now. If it’s a waste, then so be it. Anyway, she wasn’t going to move. 
Let them imprison him, what’s the difference where she lies down?
Others were busy vying for favor, dancing in the garden in winter wearing thin silk. Cheng Wanyun was curled up by the stove, watching the snow while nibbling on delicious roast duck.
Others were busy scheming for power, secretly sowing discord to incite punishment in the palace. Cheng Wanyun was raising her child, taking care of cats and dogs.
Others were busy forming factions, with the First Consort and Second Consort standing in opposition. Cheng Wanyun was sipping on milk tea, playing cards: “Boom!”
She had unknowingly reached the forty-seventh year of Kangxi’s reign and finally wondered: Why hadn’t she been discarded yet?
After Yinreng accepted Cheng Gege (Low-ranking concubine) as his concubine, he slept with her, occasionally having strange dreams, all of which came true. Over time, he remembered more and more. It turned out those were his past life memories—conflict with his father, infighting with his brothers, the early death of a younger brother, his eventual downfall, and his death in isolation.
Despite his fragmented memories, he cautiously navigated every step, walking on thin ice. Meanwhile, Cheng Gege… slept soundly without a care.
Yinreng: So angry. 
But he still gently lowered his head and tucked the blanket around her.
Perhaps the divine heavens knew his path would be full of hardship, so they blessed him with a small lucky star. He was bloodied, wielding a sword through the battlefield, while she was his peaceful haven, his paradise.

98640.synopsis:
A lifetime of loyalty to her clan and its leader earned her nothing but false accusations of espionage and the death of her family.
At the brink of despair, Sehwa experiences a miracle.
“So, what do you think of this proposal?”
She opens her eyes to find herself back at the very moment she was betrothed to the man she admired.
The same man who, despite her unwavering trust, had mercilessly poured poison down her throat.
Determined to avoid the tragic path she once walked, Sehwa chooses a different, yet equally th**ny, road.
“I will go to the Baek Clan. But please, rescind the order for me to be betrothed to the Young Lord.”
She seeks refuge with the very man she had considered her enemy all her life—the only one who can now offer her salvation.

104016.synopsis:
I became a corrupt official in a ruined world novel.
I’ve schemed so much that even the princess in charge of the empire’s military and the emperor are all infatuated with me.
But if things continue like this, my gruesome death is certain.
I must save the empire somehow.

106064.synopsis:
The Demon Lord, Di Jiang, had fought his way through the three realms, yet after achieving ultimate victory, he found himself growing weary of his long and invincible life.
So, he bathed and changed into clean clothes, preparing to drink himself into oblivion and fade into eternal silence. However, just as he lifted his head, his gaze locked onto the woman serving him wine—
Le Gui’s inner thoughts: [What are you looking at? Have you fallen for me?] 
Di Jiang: ?
This woman, Le Gui, was a disciple from the Hehuan Sect, presented to him as a tribute.
On the very day he had decided to end his life, he suddenly realized he could hear her thoughts.
When he drank—
Le Gui: [Oh wow, a beautiful man drinking. Once he’s done, maybe we could get a little… wild?] 
When he rested—
Le Gui: [His abs are showing. Is he doing this on purpose for me to see?] 
When he went out to kill—
Le Gui: [What a ruthless and deadly heartthrob. The Demon King is spicier than the spiciest devil.] 
The more timid she acted on the outside, the bolder her thoughts ran wild inside.
Di Jiang decided not to die just yet. He wanted to see just how shameless this woman could be.
—
Le Gui had transmigrated into a xianxia novel, becoming a minor cannon fodder character who served the male supporting role, Di Jiang.
To return to the real world, she needed to become Di Jiang’s queen and obtain the artifact that allowed her to travel between worlds.
But…
The fearsome Demon Lord was terrifying. She did not dare to make a move. The only thing she could do was flirt with him in her thoughts.
Yet, for some reason, the Demon Lord’s gaze on her became increasingly strange…
Later…
By some stroke of luck, she actually became Di Jiang’s queen.
On their wedding night, she eagerly attempted to leave, only to discover that the artifact was useless.
The real one was in the hands of the male lead.
It seemed… she had seduced the wrong man.
—
A struggling college student who can only rant in her head vs. A world-weary Demon Lord whose limits keep getting tested.
associated_names: 魔君听见我要攻略他[穿书]

106832.synopsis:
Three months of endlessly repeating days.
One day, they donated 1 billion won from a lottery jackpot to a Hako VTuber with only around 10 viewers in real-time.
associated_names: I Became a Whale for Small-Time VTubers

107344.synopsis:
An academy harem story where cute youngsters create adorable tales. For the heroines here, something more important than personal strength exists: the affection of readers and the choice of the protagonist.
But I have absolutely no interest in the competition for the human male protagonist. I simply want to become, once again, the strongest that no one can ever approach.

107600.synopsis:
As the biggest rebel of the Canglan World, Chang Li binds System 143 to search for the reincarnation of his first love, Jinni. He travels across myriad worlds to complete tasks—ostensibly helping others defy fate and change their destiny, but in reality, seeking Jinni. Thus begins his undefeated, world-dominating quick transmigration career.
[World 1: He is the Domineering CEO Male Lead’s Hapless Friend] 
Gu Changli, who constantly acts as a relationship catalyst, gains the female lead as a sworn sister, and loses half his family fortune: “One slap for the female lead, two slaps for the male lead! Anyone else who keeps running their mouth gets the Eighteen Dragon-Subduing Palms!”
A certain ‘green tea’ Movie Star, starry-eyed: “Baby, your friends are so annoying~ Unlike me, I only know how to dote on my Baby~”
The wolf in sheep’s clothing, Movie Star Xie, smelled his chance and latched right on.
[World 2: He is the Tragic Male Lead of a Historical Angst Novel] 
Liang Jue / Chang Li, the male lead of an angst novel whose life is a “tragedy” (pun in original Chinese) from beginning to end: “Anyone who wants to ab*se me better first consider if they have enough bones for me to burn!”
The great General Lu, charging into battle for love: “I fight for you, and would die without regret! In this world, I’m the one who most hopes you can live a good life.”
[World 3: He is the Male Supporting Character’s Amnesiac Only Son] 
Everyone has their own way of being unhinged: the tyrannical uncle who fancies his brother-in-law, the deranged widowed father, the ‘player’ aunt who’s only into women…
Chang Li: “This world has finally reached a level of crazy I can no longer comprehend!”
System 143: “A whole family of crazies! Just get rid of them all!”
associated_names: 快穿：釣系美人渾身反骨魅力滿格

107856.synopsis: One day, I suddenly became a vampire.

109392.synopsis:
[Set in the 1970s + Space + Broken Engagement + Golden Finger + Family Life + Attractive Leads] 
After transmigrating to the 1970s, the first hurdle Xue Miaoyun faced was having her engagement broken off. She didn’t mind the breakup itself, but when she learned that part of her “golden finger” (cheat ability) was tied to the token given to her fiancé during their engagement, she panicked.
After waiting in vain for the token to be returned, Xue Miaoyun decides to take matters into her own hands and travels thousands of miles to the military base to retrieve it herself. 
Her journey was filled with twists and turns, but once she successfully got back what belonged to her, she was ready to return home. However, her ex-fiancé’s superior suddenly expressed his desire to pursue a relationship with her.
Xue Miaoyun, a staunch non-believer in marriage, looks at the man standing before her—with broad shoulders, a narrow waist, long legs, sharp brows, starry eyes, and a stunningly handsome face. A total catch!
